title: Read a command status
summary: Bash: Read a command status. Try exit 0.
introduction: A command returns an exit status. Zero usually means success. $? reads the last status.
learningObjectives: Read a command status with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The subshell returns status 3. Saving $? immediately preserves that status.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Read $? immediately; the next command replaces it.
